A [[Unidentified slicer (Zentine Dynamics)|slicer]] hiding on the astronomical object [[Verroth]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the plans for a new '''prototype shuttle''' from<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Zentine Dynamics]]<ref name="TOR" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Corporate Espionage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the then-[[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to Verroth to retrieve the stolen [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] plans. The companion sliced into the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer's]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]], recovering the shuttle designs and deleting the latter's files.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prototype shuttle was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Corporate Espionage" of [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
